title: The Last Analog Bookstore
author: Sam Whitfield
body:
There's a bookstore downtown that has never sold an e-reader, never installed a self-checkout, and doesn't have wifi. The owner says that's the point.

"People don't come here for convenience," she told me. "They come here to slow down."

It shouldn't work in this economy, and yet somehow it's busier than ever. Maybe because it's one of the last places left that isn't trying to optimize you into buying something you didn't come in for.
